title: Decomposing Centrally Symmetric Convex Polyhedral Surfaces into Parallelograms
summary: Let $\mathcal{M}_{2N}(δ_1, δ_2,\dots, δ_N)$ be the moduli space of centrally symmetric convex polyhedral surfaces with $2N$ labeled vertices and prescribed cone-deficits $δ_1$, $δ_2$, $\dots$, $δ_N$. We show that $\mathcal{M}_{2N}(δ_1, δ_2,\dots, δ_N)$ has the structure of a real hyperbolic manifold of dimension $2N-3$. When $N=4$ and $5$, we show that every surface in $\mathcal{M}_{2N}(δ_1, δ_2,\dots, δ_N)$ can be decomposed into at most $2\binom{2N-2}{2}$ parallelograms, and the decomposition is invariant under the antipodal map.
